newsitem.title: USA: ReliaStar to acquire Kinnard unit.
newsitem.headline: ReliaStar to acquire Kinnard unit.

text.p: ReliaStar Financial Corp said it reached a definitive agreement to acquire PrimeVest Financial Services Inc, a subsidiary of Kinnard Investments Inc, for $15.5 million in cash.
The transaction is expected to close in late October.
Contingent on this closing date, Kinnard said it expects to recognize a gain from the divestiture of about $1.08 per share in its fourth quarter earnings results.
ReliaStar said the transaction will not have a material impact on its 1996 earnings results.
PrimeVest Financial is a full-service, third-party marketing firm offering mutual funds, stocks and bonds, variable and fixed annuities, life insurance and other financial products and services.

ReliaStar said PrimeVest's established relationships with more than 600 financial institutions and full-service bank marketing capability will enable ReliaStar to increase its presence in this market.
"PrimeVest was purchased by Kinnard in 1991 as a means to expand market share in the financial services industry," said Kinnard chairman Hilding Nelson in a statement.
"While we continue to be optimistic about PrimeVest's future, we do not believe that the value of the company is being accurately reflected in the price of Kinnard's stock," Nelson added.

Kinnard Investments is a financial services holding company. ReliaStar Financial is a holding company that offers individual life insurance and annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, mutual funds and personal finance education.
